rows.surface: Per-clone sentinel probes through ordinary public API paths, without network admission changes
rows.mechanism: Off by default; per-profile diagnostic settings are stored separately from identity and compatibility policies. Daemon supplies bounded sibling paths and existing nonce-bound SSH acceptance seed evidence. In-clone Foundation/Security/defaults/pasteboard probes execute after hook readiness, on foreground return, and periodically (default 15 minutes while scheduled by iOS). Successful foreign reads or blocked-policy clipboard visibility report LEAK. Missing/expired witnesses and inconclusive errors report NOT_RUN. Optional clipboard write challenge is separately off by default. No automatic gate close/open, hook replacement, or entitlement changes. Reports bind the current process, generation, clone-scoped boot epoch and control revision; the observer itself never changes an active gate. Subsequent launch admission rejects retained findings even if sentinel settings are OFF, and unreadable safety state fails closed. Current evidence additionally requires the daemon coordinator's active launch identity, a fresh kernel PID/birth/executable observation, explicit profile/lease/readiness agreement, and a second unchanged daemon identity sample. No provider, closed lease, reused PID or changed authority yields current evidence. For an eligible active clone, durable operation ownership is established before consuming its report. LEAK quarantine and alert publish together through the checked compare-and-write store API, then read back. Failed or interrupted publication retains the operation journal and requires recovery before subsequent mutations/admission; successful retention retires ownership while keeping per-profile quarantine. Observer has no network close/open call.
